dispatches.title: Welcome to the practice
dispatches.body:
This is where Marcus reaches you: a new feature now and then, an occasional notice, nothing more.

No daily nudges live here, and no noise. Reminders stay in your notifications, and only if you ask for them. Check this page whenever you like. There will rarely be much.

The practice itself is simple. Show up, set your intention, examine your day. Begin when you are ready.

dispatches.title: Daily Meditations, if you want it
dispatches.body: A short letter runs alongside the app: one verified passage from the Stoics, the moment in history that produced it, and a single question to carry into the day. Two minutes to read, free, and easy to leave.
